scope: MSG interface and deterministic code tests only; not full I1 receiver, no real experiment or cost reallocation

decoder.legacy_API: decode_llr retains (hard,ok), identical operations and syndrome early stop; capture disabled
decoder.new_API: decode_soft_messages / decoder_messages: incoming_llr, raw_app, raw_check_extrinsic, iterations, syndrome_trace
decoder.equation: raw_check_extrinsic=sum incoming check-to-variable messages; raw_app=incoming_llr+raw_check_extrinsic. Never subtract separately clipped arrays.
decoder.ordering: all I bits then all Q bits; log P(bit0)/P(bit1)
decoder.clip: raw outputs preserved; clipping/damping occurs only in consumer
decoder.limitation: loopy sum-product and syndrome early stop are approximate posterior inference

consumers.detector_code_prior: check-sum extrinsic only, legal code-factor message
consumers.CE_posterior_moments: APP allowed: mu=a*tanh(LI/2)+j*a*tanh(LQ/2), var=2a^2-|mu|^2; marginal product, same-observation approximate EM; not independent extrinsic likelihood
consumers.zero: detector extrinsic exactly zero including previous-state damping; uniform code prior
consumers.fixed_sham: explicit fixed seeded permutation of raw check extrinsic only; no CE APP shuffle
consumers.disabled: consumer returns enabled=false and no replacement state; old decoder exact compatibility tested, entire receiver disabled-feedback integration remains I-01 work
consumers.oracle: separate oracle_symbols requires I2/I2realloc tag, true_symbols_oracle and legal_receiver_input=false; no Htruth interface

bounds.hashes: incoming, raw APP, raw check extrinsic, delivered, consumer kind
bounds.entropy: mean marginal binary entropy in bits
bounds.cost: decoder and consumer elapsed measured; no full receiver timing claim

validation.command: python -m unittest afdm_sp_joint_unrolled.test_supplement_messages plus two named NumericalContracts regressions
